name: 我真的不是暴君
overview: When legendary slacker Wei Yang accidentally transmigrates into the body of Daliang’s emperor Li Chengze, he hopes for a leisurely life—but every attempt to dodge responsibility backfires spectacularly. His misguided plans spark victories, expose corruption, and win him loyal ministers and the people’s support, all while he grows unexpectedly close to strategist Xiao Huaijin.
